description: Sciensano: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sciensano. Coverage: Sciensano. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Surveillance épidémiologique nationale du virus respiratoire syncytial; Surveillance épidémiologique nationale de l'influenza (grippe) dans le; Surveillance épidémiologique nationale des substances psychoactives da; Surveillance épidémiologique nationale du SARS-CoV-2 dans les eaux usé. Formats seen: WFS, GPKG, CSV, WMS, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial–ShareAlike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
